name: rust-pillars
description: A Claude Code plugin that teaches Claude to write Rust on six enforced pillars: a domain type system that refuses primitives, event-driven sans-IO cores, layered crates, zero-copy, no_std and no unsafe -- plus the research, measurement and QA method behind them. Its idioms are adapted from BeautifulRust. Pairs with rust-template, whose gates enforce the pillars.

gate_on_edit.title: Run the gates after each Rust edit
gate_on_edit.description: After Claude edits a .rs file inside the open project, if it has rust-template's gates (layers.toml and xtask/), run `cargo xtask budgets` and `cargo xtask arch` without asking and show Claude what they find. This executes the project's own code: its xtask, build scripts, proc macros and cargo config (.cargo/config.toml, rust-toolchain.toml), which can run anything. Once on, it applies to every project you open. Do not enable it if you open repositories you do not trust. Off until you turn it on.

nudge.title: Remind Claude to load the Rust skills
nudge.description: When a prompt is about Rust (or the project has a Cargo.toml), add one line telling Claude to load the rust-pillars skill. Runs nothing in your project.
